auditor_ben: Hi all — auditor requested a compact evidentiary bundle for a service-account RBAC update that led to KMS decrypts. Need: PR link + approvers, Jira ticket, cloud audit row showing the IAM change, KMS decrypt events for the same principal/timeframe, vuln-triage note (if related), and manifest with checksum and packager identity.

nico_seceng: Understood. We'll assemble: GitHub PR #4012, Jira ENG-6140, cloud audit slice, kms log slice, triage.md, and manifest.txt with sha256.

rachel_cloud: GCP export query I used: `protoPayload.methodName:"SetIamPolicy" AND resource.type:"service_account" AND protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:ci-runner@*` time window 2026-06-20T02:00Z..2026-06-20T03:00Z. I exported one matching row.

max_oncall: PR 4012 shows reviewers `@nico_seceng` and `@max_oncall` approved. Comment: "limited secret access granted for backup-rotate only". Link: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4012

rachel_cloud: IAM diff (redacted) snippet: `{"timestamp":"2026-06-20T02:12:11Z","actor":"nico_seceng@redwood-inference.com","target":"serviceAccounts/ci-runner@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com","bindings_before":["roles/storage.objectViewer"],"bindings_after":["roles/storage.objectViewer","roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor"]}`

nico_seceng: KMS logs from logs-redwood-kms (sanitized):
```
2026-06-20T02:12:12Z principalEmail=ci-runner@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com action=decrypt key=projects/redwood/locations/us/keyRings/ops/cryptoKeys/backups-enc version=7
2026-06-20T02:12:13Z principalEmail=ci-runner@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com action=decrypt key=projects/redwood/locations/us/keyRings/ops/cryptoKeys/backups-enc version=7
```

auditor_ben: Good. Two follow-ups: (1) who packaged the bundle and checksum? (2) prove logs are immutable/retained per policy.

nico_seceng: Packaging: `tools/compliance/package_evidence.sh --ticket=ENG-6140 --start=2026-06-20T02:00Z --end=2026-06-20T03:00Z`. Packaged_by=nico_seceng, packaged_at=2026-06-21T11:05:00Z. Manifest contains entries and `sha256: 7e2d9f...`.

opsbot: EvidenceBuilder: job started by nico_seceng at 2026-06-21T11:05:02Z job_id=evid-20260621-1105

rachel_cloud: Export storage: s3://redwood-compliance/eng-6140/ with Object Lock (governance) 365d retention. ACL restricted to `compliance-role` and `ops-bot`. I'll attach `aws s3api get-object-retention` sample in the bundle.

devrel_kim: I'll add a simple timeline PNG mapping PR -> Jira -> deploy job -> KMS decrypt to help non-technical reviewers. Also adding `readme.txt` mapping artifacts to SOC2/ISO control text.

max_oncall: Triage: this change was remediation for RD-2026-42 (backup job couldn't rotate secrets). triage.md includes root cause, mitigation, verification commands (`gcloud iam service-accounts get-iam-policy ci-runner@...` and `gcloud kms keys list --location=us --keyring=ops`).

auditor_ben: Please produce a deterministic hash mapping of principals (so we can match without exposing raw emails): `principal_hashes.csv` with sha256(ci-runner@...) entries is fine. Auditor may request unhashed mapping under NDA.

nico_seceng: Included `principal_hashes.csv` and cert that unhashed mapping is stored in the compliance vault. Bundle uploaded: s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/ENG-6140/evid-20260621-1105.zip size=2.6MB checksum=7e2d9f... retention=365d.

opsbot: EvidenceBuilder: upload complete job_id=evid-20260621-1105 status=success

auditor_ben: Received. I'll review the manifest and circle back if they need the unhashed principal mapping or additional logs. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
